ask: Investigate the printable GT2-corner-pinion interface: design a 3D-printable PETG corner module where a GT2-6M belt turns 90° and drives a face-panel pinion, using the FANUC EP0426859 tensioner principle for backlash elimination at small scale. Search for: (1) existing published designs or patents for printed spur/pinion gears meshing with GT2 belt teeth — especially at non-parallel shaft orientations; (2) the GT2 tooth geometry (0.76mm tall, curved profile, 2mm pitch) and whether a printed PETG gear cut with matching tooth profile can achieve meaningful mesh without slipping under 0.5Nm; (3) the minimum printable tooth count before undercut on a 0.5mm module gear with 0.2mm layer height; (4) any academic or maker testing of printed timing-belt pulleys or pinions under load. Return: a printable corner-pinion tooth profile (SVG or OpenSCAD code), a materials/infill recommendation, and a torque-test protocol to validate mesh before full cube build.
